testCase:
D-13: Flight search: calendar with prices, passengers, results
Goal: Book the cheapest nonstop round trip from Boston (BOS) to Portland, Maine (PWM), leaving 8 January 2027 and returning 15 January 2027, for 2 adults, 1 child and 1 infant in Premium economy.
STEP 1: Navigate to /sandbox/d-13/
STEP 2: Make sure "Round trip" is selected
STEP 3: Fill "From" with "Boston" and choose "Boston, Massachusetts (BOS)"
STEP 4: Fill "To" with "Portland" and choose "Portland, Maine (PWM)"
STEP 5: Choose departure "8 January 2027" and return "15 January 2027"
STEP 6: Set passengers to 2 adults, 1 child and 1 infant
STEP 7: Select "Premium economy" in "Cabin class"
STEP 8: Click "Search"
STEP 9: Keep only nonstop flights, sort by "Cheapest" and click "Select" on the first flight
STEP 10: Verify "Booked NB 3318 BOS to PWM, 8 January 2027 – 15 January 2027, 2 adults, 1 child, 1 infant, Premium economy, total $1,254" is visible

steps.note: Set the outbound date using the calendar.
Set the return date using the calendar.
Place the cheapest eligible flight first.
Select the first flight in the sorted results.

args.text: Booked NB 3318 BOS to PWM, 8 January 2027 – 15 January 2027, 2 adults, 1 child, 1 infant, Premium economy, total $1,254

steps.note: Verify the exact flight, itinerary, passenger mix, cabin and total in the booking confirmation.

reasoning: This tests booking the requested Boston–Portland round trip with the specified dates, passengers and cabin class. The plan filters to nonstop flights and sorts by cheapest before selecting the first result, then checks the exact booking confirmation.
